title: OpenCMO default posting slots
description: How Schedule proposes a time (schedule-publish.md §5): default local times per platform, the gap and caps, the firing window. SQL's schedule_rules() returns the same object; apps/web/lib/cmo/schedule-defaults.check.ts compares them in check:contracts.

minGapHours.description: Least time between two posts on one platform.

windowMinutes.description: After the approved time plus jitter, how long a slot may still fire; past it the slot is missed, never posted late.

leadMinutes.description: A proposed time is at least this far from now, so the founder has time to approve it.

horizonDays.description: How many days ahead a proposal looks for a free slot.

maxProposals.description: Times one deliverable is proposed on one platform before Schedule stops asking.

jitterSeconds.description: Natural posting: a slot fires up to this many seconds either side of its time.
